title: 12 Best Darjeeling First Flush Tea Walks
description: Discover the 12 best First Flush tea walks in Darjeeling for 2026. Explore historic estates, savor exquisite teas, and learn about tea production in the Himalayas. Your ultimate guide to Darjeeling's tea country.

places.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Guided Factory Tour and First Flush Tea Tasting

places.name: Glenburn Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹1,500-3,000+ per person (~$18-36+ USD) for day visit with activities
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Full-Day Tea Experience package including a guided walk, factory visit, and a tasting of their premium First Flush teas.

places.name: Makaibari Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹300-500 per person (~$4-6 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Guided Eco-Tour with a focus on their biodynamic practices, followed by a tasting of Makaibari's special First Flush.

places.name: Puttabong Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹400-600 per person (~$5-7 USD) for guided tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Pioneers' Walk' focusing on the estate's history and a tasting of their high-grade First Flush.

places.name: Badamtam Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹300-500 per person (~$4-6 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Guided Plantation Walk leading to the river, followed by a tasting of their classic First Flush.

places.name: Singtom Tea Estate & Resort
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Estate Tour with a focus on their sustainable practices and a formal First Flush tasting session.

places.name: Gopaldhara Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹200-400 per person (~$2-5 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A detailed factory tour combined with a comprehensive tasting of their varied First Flush offerings.

places.name: Chamong Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹250-450 per person (~$3-5 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Guided tour highlighting organic and Fair Trade practices, culminating in a tasting of Chamong's premium First Flush.

places.name: Goomtee Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹350-550 per person (~$4-7 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Traditional Tea Estate Tour with emphasis on Orthodox processing, followed by a connoisseur's tasting of their First Flush.

places.name: Tukvar Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹250-450 per person (~$3-5 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Valley View Tea Walk and an in-depth tasting of their Muscatel First Flush.

places.name: North Tukvar Tea Estate
places.priceRange: ₹250-450 per person (~$3-5 USD) for tour and tasting
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order High-Altitude Plantation Walk and a comparison tasting of North Tukvar's First Flush against other flushes.

places.name: Maharani Hills Tea Centre (near Selim Hill)
places.priceRange: ₹100-200 per person (~$1-2 USD) for basic tasting/cafe items
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of freshly brewed First Flush Darjeeling tea with a plate of local 'momos' or scones.
